turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Well, I guess I'm here because I just can't seem to keep myself together lately. Since my daughter left for basic training, I feel like I come home to a dead house. 

It's really starting to affect everything. I'm sitting there crying in my truck before my shifts even start. At work, I'm missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, and I keep snapping at the younger guys on the floor. When I get home, I don't do much. I've stopped going out on the water, and I haven't been working on my sculpture at all because... I don't know, I just don’t see the point anymore. I just need to figure out how to get a grip on things.
